topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: When old Thom come back from the town, all sleek and clean, I thought he'd carry tales of far-off places and grand folks. But his face fell when he saw me, like a storm cloud rolling in after a harvest. He said he met with a lad from his youth, one who meant the world to him once, but the lad couldn’t recall Thom or their days together. Poor Thom, his eyes went wide and lost, like a lamb separated from its mother. I put a hand on his shoulder, steady as the earth, and told him that memories fade like the last light of day, but the heart remembers. I offered him a cup of ale, warm and rich, and we sat by the fire, spinning tales of the days when the world was young and boundless, till the night swallowed the last star.
